products.title: (Pre-Order) The Fermentation Project Kit
products.body_html:
What is the Fermentation Project?

The Fermentation Project was designed to explore this relationship in a simple but powerful way: keeping everything constant except the fermentation method.

https://thefermentationproject.com

What's included?

Each Fermentation Project Kit contains 80g of 4 coffees created from the same starting material and processed using different fermentation approaches:

  • yeast inocultated
  • mechanically washed
  • lactobacillus
  • wild fermentation

All 4 coffees in this set come from the same farm, the same harvest, the same varieties, and were processed under the supervision of fermentation specialist Lucia Solis. The only variable is the fermentation approach.

This allows participants to experience firsthand how different fermentation methods can influence the final cup.

For additional information click this link

Coffee Information
Origin: Antigua Valley, Guatemala
Farm: Finca San Miguel Urias
Producers: Hector and Lilian Leal
Operated by: Rueda Farms
Location: Between Ciudad Vieja and San Miguel Dueñas, within the genuine Antigua Valley denomination
Altitude: 1,460–1,540 masl
Variety: ~85% Caturra, ~15% H1, with a small percentage of Bourbon


When exactly will my kit ship? Coffees will roast on September 22st and ship out on September 25th, timed so your coffee has time to rest before the October 3rd tasting.
